name: Ninsan Bakeshichi
source:
People die over tuna.
Witness the birth of the world's first Japanese-style tuna horror visual novel, depicting the youth and conspiracies of Tuna University.

[Translated from [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/1371528]booth[/url]]
